capabilities: Render empty markdown links as inline pills with favicon and page title
Fetch page metadata client-side via Obsidian's requestUrl
Resolve favicons from HTML link tags with a /favicon.ico fallback
Leave normal markdown links with custom text untouched
extras: Sites with aggressive bot detection (e.g. Facebook) may return login walls; the plugin then falls back to showing the hostname.
problem: Obsidian renders bare markdown links as plain text, offering no visual link previews like Notion's link mentions.
summary: Link renderer that displays empty markdown links as inline pills with the site's favicon and page title, without modifying the source.
